items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I (Inaudible) like leaving Lil Greenwood without telling her the band was moving on. That was the way he left her.

ctx.x: I (Inaudible) like leaving Lil Greenwood without telling her the band was moving on. That was the way he left her. But he didn't tell her she was fired.
(Laughter) There's not much difference between leaving you with nothing and telling you you're fired is there?
